dashboard.subtitle: Summary of your supplies, batches and registration status.
dashboard.emptyBatchesHint: Batches appear here once a clerk registers one from your supply (UC-05).
dashboard.demoNote: Demo: the demo supplier (SP-001) is active — their mock data is shown here.

profile.subtitle: Your own registry record — read-only.
profile.note: Suppliers cannot edit this record — the registry clerk registers and edits supplier data (FR-2.6, FR-2.7).

banner.active: The record is active — supply registration and quality details are available.
banner.pending: The registration awaits verification, so sign-in is blocked. Please wait until it is approved (UC-01 step 9, BR-12).
banner.rejected: The registration was rejected, so sign-in is blocked. Contact the registry clerk if you have questions.
banner.locked: The account is temporarily locked, so sign-in is blocked. Lock duration/unlock is unresolved (BR-14, BR-15).

register.title: Register supplier
register.subtitle: Create a new supplier record. After submitting it enters the «pending verification» state (UC-01).
register.soumNone: Soums appear after choosing an aimag

error.usernameTaken: This username is registered. Choose another username.
error.duplicateSupplier: The same supplier already has a record — registration refused. Contact the registry clerk.
error.summaryRequired: Required fields are incomplete — fill the marked fields.
error.storage: The registration was not saved. A storage error occurred — your data is unchanged, please try again (UC-01 E4).

register.cancelBody: The entered data will be discarded and no record created (UC-01 A1).
register.successNote: A record in the «pending verification» state was created. You may sign in after the administrator validates it (UC-01 step 9, BR-12).
register.successDemo: Demo: check your status on the «Check registration status» page with your username/email and password.

supply.formHint: Enter the supplied cashmere amount and origin information (UC-02, FR-1.3, FR-1.4).

section.amountHint: Enter the supplied cashmere amount and date.
section.originHint: Enter the cashmere's place of origin and livestock count.

supply.soumNone: Soums appear after choosing an aimag

error.livestock: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
error.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
error.summaryRequired: Required fields are incomplete — fill the marked fields.
error.storage: The supply was not saved. A storage error occurred — your data is unchanged, please try again (UC-02 E3).

supply.cancelBody: The entered data will be discarded and no supply registered (UC-02 A1).
supply.successBody: Saved and linked to your own supplier record (BR-05).

history.title: Own supply history
history.onlyOwn: Only your own supplies are shown (BR-05).
history.emptyHint: Supplies appear here after registering them via the form above.

quality.title: Own batch quality details
quality.onlyOwn: Only your own batches and their quality parameters are shown (FR-1.5).
quality.noResultHint: It appears here once the test result is recorded (UC-08).
quality.emptyHint: Quality details appear here after a clerk registers a batch (UC-05) and the test is done.
quality.codeNote: Batch numbers use the MN-YYYY-000001 format — generated automatically with duplicate checking.
quality.blockedOther: Other suppliers' data is not shown (FR-1.5).

blockedSupply.title: Supply registration unavailable
blockedSupply.body: The system refuses registration because the record status is not «active» (UC-02 E1).
